name: finstat
description: Web based financial statement preparation: trial balance in, balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow and notes out.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @finstat/api && npm run build -w @finstat/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:env && npm run build:shared && npm run db:up && node scripts/wait-for-db.mjs && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @finstat/web
